summary: Materialise NV filed a 6-K attaching a press release updating its ongoing ADS/share buyback program. The Belgian 3D printing company reported repurchasing 43,345 shares in the 7-11 September 2026 window at an average EUR 6.44 per share, totaling EUR 279,309, all through Nasdaq's central order book with no block or cross trades. Since program inception 26 January 2026, it has bought back 1,323,060 shares for EUR 6,745,706, equal to 2.2% of shares outstanding and EUR 30 million authorized. Watch pace versus authorization, liquidity, and any signal about valuation support.
